🔬 陌生算子/字段释义

算子/字段含义
true_range真实波幅 TR = max(H-L, |H-C|, |L-C|)
ts_eman 期指数移动平均（EWMA）
ts_pctd 期变化率：(x − x_shift(d)) / x_shift(d)

📝 计算步骤（一步一步解释）

  1. 1) ret_5 = (close - ts_delay(close, 5)) / ts_delay(close, 5) 5 日动量
  2. 2) vol_ratio = volume / ts_mean(volume, 20) 量比
  3. 3) atr_20 = ts_atr(high, low, close, 20) 20 日 ATR
  4. 4) atr_norm = atr_20 / close 波动调整
  5. 5) raw = ret_5 * log(vol_ratio) * atr_norm
  6. 6) smoothed = ema(raw, span=10) EMA 平滑
  7. 7) factor = cs_rank(smoothed)
⚠ 该因子原始 IC 为负，已整体取反（×(-1)）调正方向；下列步骤展示的是原始公式的计算过程。

🐍 原始 Python 代码 (factor_delivery)

"kw">class="kw">def factor_lag_response_vol_tool_adaptive(df): df_copy = df.copy() ret_5 = df_copy["close"] / df_copy["close"].shift(5) - 1 _, _, vol_ratio = alpha_tools.classify_volume_regime(df_copy["volume"], window=30) log_vol_ratio = np.log(np.clip(vol_ratio, 1e-12, "kw">class="kw">None)) atr_20 = talib.ATR(df_copy["high"], df_copy["low"], df_copy["close"], timeperiod=20) vol_adj = atr_20 / df_copy["close"].replace(0, np.nan) raw = ret_5 * log_vol_ratio * vol_adj ema5 = raw.ewm(span=5, min_periods=5, adjust="kw">class="kw">False).mean() ema10 = raw.ewm(span=10, min_periods=10, adjust="kw">class="kw">False).mean() resvol_high_gate = df_copy["style_gate_resvol_high"] factor = np.where(resvol_high_gate > 0, ema10, ema5) df_copy["factor_lag_response_vol_tool_adaptive"] = factor "kw">class="kw">return df_copy["factor_lag_response_vol_tool_adaptive"]
